articles.title: Agility chooses Nyobolt for ultra-fast charging for Digit 5 humanoid
articles.summary: Agility Robotics selected Nyobolt to provide an ultra-fast charging battery system for its Digit 5 humanoid robot, targeting more than 20 hours of productive work per day. The system is expected to deliver 90 minutes of runtime with a nine-minute charge, improving the run-to-charge ratio from Digit 4’s 2:1 to 10:1. Early access is expected in the first half of 2027, with broader availability over the following six to nine months.

articles.title: Computational Reflective Equilibrium for Agentic AI: A Rawlsian Alignment Scaffold for Governance
articles.summary: The paper proposes Agentic Reflective Equilibrium, a governance and alignment scaffold for agentic AI systems that connects system prompts, operator policies, evidence, judgments, and candidate actions through structured support and attack relationships. It emphasizes traceability, human-in-the-loop triggers, prohibitions, provenance, and safeguards against prompt injection, illustrated through refund-assistant and hiring-agent case studies.
articles.advisor_relevance: This is an early-stage academic framework rather than a commercial deployment, but it highlights a key adoption bottleneck for agentic AI: enterprises will need auditable, policy-aware controls before allowing agents to act in sensitive workflows such as customer service, hiring, privacy, and compliance. The read-through is most relevant to AI governance, risk management, and enterprise readiness rather than near-term revenue or infrastructure spending.

articles.title: XAI-Guided Fourier Domain Generalisation for Pure-Simulation Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning
articles.summary: The paper introduces XFD, an explainable-AI-guided Fourier domain generalisation framework designed to improve sim-to-real transfer for vision-based deep reinforcement learning in autonomous driving. The method uses attribution maps from simulated observations to guide visual perturbations, aiming to preserve task-relevant spatial structures while reducing sensitivity to irrelevant appearance changes. Experiments report better zero-shot real-world performance versus standard and randomly domain-randomised baselines, especially in unseen maps with cluttered backgrounds.
articles.advisor_relevance: This is an early-stage technical research development rather than a directly investable company or product announcement. It is relevant as a signal that physical AI systems, including autonomous vehicles and robotics, are advancing methods to reduce costly real-world data collection and improve deployment robustness.
